name: log-view
purpose: Composition-based terminal log viewer for CI/deploy output. **LogView** is the root shell and context provider; **LogViewHeader**, **LogViewContent**, and **LogViewFooter** are composed as children so teams can reorder, omit, or replace the toolbar and footer without forking the log renderer.
useWhen: Showing build, deploy or CI output as timestamped lines the reader can search, filter to warnings, and copy.
A log shell whose toolbar and footer vary by screen — compose `LogViewHeader`, `LogViewContent` and `LogViewFooter` in the order you need, or drop the ones you don't.
A log that is still loading from the server — set `loading` to show a spinner and `loading-label` in place of the body.
avoidWhen: Static, read-only code or configuration snippets → use `code-block`.
An animated terminal session on a marketing page → use `cli-terminal`.
Rows of structured records with columns, sorting or paging → use `table`.
related: code-block` — highlighted source code with a copy action, not a stream of typed log lines.
cli-terminal` — marketing band that plays a scripted terminal session.
deploy-success` — the post-deploy screen that embeds `log-view` for the build log.
bestPractices: Give every line a stable `id` and a `type` (`text`, `folder`, `framework-version`, `success`, `warning`); the type drives the line's rendering and the warnings filter.
Bind `v-model:search` and `v-model:warnings-only` when the app needs the filter state; otherwise leave them unbound and the header manages them.
Set `:bordered="false"` when the log sits inside a surface that already frames it (an accordion panel, a drawer).
The copy control hides while `disabled` or `loading`, or when there is nothing to copy; listen to `@copy` for the copied text instead of reading the clipboard.
Use the header's `left` / `right` / `search` slots and the footer's default slot to add actions, rather than rebuilding the toolbar.

props.name: lines
props.doc: Log entries; filtered in LogViewContent by search and warnings-only.

props.name: bordered
props.doc: Draw the outer card border and corner radius around the log shell. On by default; set `:bordered="false"` to render the shell flush inside a surface that already frames it (an accordion panel, a drawer). Internal dividers (header/footer edges) are unaffected.

props.name: searchPlaceholder
props.doc: Placeholder for the default header search field. Empty uses the locale catalog (`Find in logs`).

props.name: copyable
props.doc: Shows the copy-to-clipboard control (a CopyButton pinned top-right over the log content in LogViewContent).

props.name: loading
props.doc: Replaces the LogViewContent log body with a centered spinner and label.

props.name: loadingLabel
props.doc: Label shown beneath the spinner while `loading`. Empty uses the locale catalog (`Loading…`).

events.name: copy
events.notes: Fires after a successful copy; payload is the copied plain text.

slots.name: default
slots.notes: Sub-components (LogViewHeader, LogViewContent, LogViewFooter) composed in the desired order.

examples.name: Default
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import LogView from '@aziontech/webkit/log-view'
  import LogViewHeader from '@aziontech/webkit/log-view-header'
  import LogViewContent from '@aziontech/webkit/log-view-content'
  import { ref } from 'vue'

  const lines = [
    { id: '1', time: '13:47:33', type: 'text', message: 'Deploy started successfully!' },
    { id: '2', time: '13:47:41', type: 'success', message: 'Build finished' },
    {
      id: '3',
      time: '13:47:42',
      type: 'folder',
      message: 'dist/index.js',
      folderType: 'asset',
      size: '12.4 kB',
      gzipSize: '4.1 kB'
    },
    { id: '4', time: '13:47:43', type: 'warning', message: 'Bundle larger than recommended' }
  ]
  const search = ref('')
  const warningsOnly = ref(false)
</script>

<template>
  <LogView
    :lines="lines"
    v-model:search="search"
    v-model:warnings-only="warningsOnly"
    class="h-[640px]"
  >
    <LogViewHeader />
    <LogViewContent />
  </LogView>
</template>
